document_requirements.instructions: Please explain your financial status (100–200 words in English or German)
TUM grade report (can be downloaded from TUMonline)
two recommendations not older than one semester. Deadline: 15 November / 15 May

bank statements of the past 12 months of all bank accounts. If not in German or English language, a certified German translation is required by a sworn translator (with official seal!) (winter term: 01 October – 30 September and summer term: 01 April – 31 March). If there are incoming payments, please explain directly on the bank account statement what kind of payment it is
Birth certificates of your own children

Proof of parents‘ income or proof of income of spouse if applicable (12 months) if not in German or English language, a certified German translation is required by a sworn translator (with official seal!) not older than one year
Certificate of residence registration of the spouse, if he/she lives in Germany
